description: Crop a width x height region starting at offset x, y and write it to the output path.

height.description: Height in pixels of the crop region. Must be greater than 0.

input.description: Path to the source image file to crop.

output.description: Path where the cropped image will be written.

width.description: Width in pixels of the crop region. Must be greater than 0.

x.description: Horizontal offset in pixels of the crop region's starting corner. Must be 0 or greater.

y.description: Vertical offset in pixels of the crop region's starting corner. Must be 0 or greater.

name: crop_image
